name: Raspberry Pi RP2040
five_v_note: RP2040 datasheet: 'Fault Tolerant' pins only means little current flows below 3.63V when IOVDD is 0V. Not 5V tolerant.

flash_psram_gpio.notes: Flash is on dedicated QSPI pins (not GPIO). BOOTSEL is on QSPI_SS, not a GPIO.

usb_note: USB D+/D- are dedicated pins, not GPIO.
notes: Every chip GPIO is safe at chip level; boards remove the ones they use internally (Pico: 23/24/25/29; Pico W: 23/24/25/29 radio).

platformio.platform: raspberrypi (official, Arduino-Mbed core) or https://github.com/maxgerhardt/platform-raspberrypi.git (community, Earle Philhower arduino-pico core)

board_level.physical pin 1-40: Pico header number, NOT a GPIO
board_level.D{n}: some RP2040 boards (e.g. Arduino Nano RP2040 Connect) use Arduino numbers; look up the board

provenance.notes: Fault-tolerant definition quoted from datasheet pad table.
